title: ControlSystems LQRGainSchedule

stats.done_summary: Completed gain-scheduled LQR controller design with H-infinity constraint verification. Deliverables: (1) code/gain_scheduled_lqr.py - runnable simulation code with GainScheduledLQR class implementing linear interpolation, anti-windup compensation, and H-infinity norm verification; (2) report/report.md - comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and discussion; (3) report/images/ - 5 figures showing state trajectories, control input, scheduling/gain adaptation, H-infinity norm verification, and LQR gains at operating points. Key results: H-infinity norm max=0.8028 < 1.0 threshold (constraint satisfied), smooth gain interpolation across z∈[1,4], anti-windup for ±0.9 saturation limits implemented.
